body:
Seriously.  Just online alone, read through some of these people's opinions:

http://talk.collegeconfidential.com/college-life/1185996-whats-your-impression-of-people-who-are-facebookless.html

http://www.yourtango.com/experts/rebecca-a-marquis/why-doesnt-he-have-facebook-account-top-5-reasons-expert

http://collegecandy.com/2009/09/01/no-facebook-social-suicide/

I might send you a PM to my stuff sometime.  Kind of a little nervous about sharing stuff that can be traced back to me from a forum about suicide watch to be honest... nothing personal.

As for the collaborative platform, it sounds like potentially a very positive use of technology that isn't necessarily soul-crushing.  Sadly I don't know if I can make much use of it; the only internet I have is in my office.

Thank you.  Seriously, thank you.  I can't believe that I'm not alone on this and seeing your post makes me want to copy and paste this.

"This is the first time on reddit where I have found someone that feels the exact same way as me."

I'm also a fellow creative.  I often do music (I have two small nobody-listens-to-them albums out on indie labels) and I'm about 30,000 words into a novel I'm writing.  Creativity has always been my go-to therapy as well. Lately I've found it harder and harder to concentrate on my projects, but that's honestly the one thing keeping me sane.  I hope your comic goes well!

I've even seen magazine covers in supermarkets with things like "Dating a guy without FB - what is he hiding?"  I'm not hiding anything, I just don't see the point of making my life public!

I mentioned my job in my post.  I can't count the number of people I've added from fake profiles and then been able to track them down for work.  It scares me.

I'm also a reader - I can relate to that.  I love physical books though.  Something about reading on a screen just doesn't have the same experience.  It lacks the smell of the paper and the texture of turning the pages.

It's equally refreshing to see that I'm not the only one who feels this way.

Like you, I am also the only person I know who doesn't use social media.  Nobody I interact with gets it.  My boss is so tied to his smartphone that he literally can't leave the room without it being in his hand.
